name: [DAILY🍀] Apex RNG!
desc:
Welcome to Apex RNG! 👋🍀

🎆30X LUCK EVENT🍀

This game is an rng and simulator combined, explore and roll over 60+ different, unique and rare auras, 💎
Forge charms to increase your luck and speed, 💨
Find ancient potions around the map and drink them for special buffs, 🧪
Over 11+ Biomes to explore and discover, 🗺️
And reach the leaderboards and flex! 🏆

Chapter 2 has arrived and with its features! [FISHING AND MERCHANT!!🐟]

MACROING IS ALLOWED -> YOU WON'T GET BANNED

This is a solo-dev project made by a 13 year old kid, don't expect huge updates. 
Inspired by sols rng, I do not want it to be a direct copy but I want the gameplay to feel similar to sols. Over time the game should develop its own style.

Made with ❤️ by BG3SF
